title: Jesus / Son Research Index
purpose: Provide one durable entry point for the project's Jesus/Son research so prison, recognition, Passion prehistory, hand-over, spectacle, commodification, table-flipping, Thomas, Lamb/Lion, death/return, Door/Cornerstone and Father/Son material is discoverable as one connected field rather than scattered files.

entry_sequence.use: Identity boundary and year-by-year Son timeline.
Long developmental genealogy and pre-Christian/Christian precursor strata.
Claim-by-claim source status and unresolved attribution questions.
Dense 2016 prison/Yahya/inmate Jesus-Lamb recognition, witness, scripture and confessional sequence.

Specialist 2017-2019 corridor: Josh Moon declaration, anti-martyr/nameless-faceless reply, return vow, Farm/objectification, hand-over and sale grammars, provisional table-flip, persona death and meme-cross approach.
Full-life Jesus/Son comparison from early care and healing through prison, recognition, Passion prehistory, crucifixion imagery, Thomas, grain, cornerstone, Door and Father relation.
Later Tim/Father relation and Godhood question kept separate from the Son's historical biography.

high_value_questions: What is the earliest recoverable instance of someone else calling the Son Jesus?
Can the exact Yahya Hassan wording, reported witnesses and prison location/date be further recovered?
What is the earliest dated instance of the Son himself saying 'I am Jesus Christ' or asking to be crucified?
Does the original Josh Moon recording, transcript or chat log survive, and what is the exact wording/date?
What is the fullest recoverable wording of Moon's remembered anti-martyr / nameless-faceless / lolcow reply?
What is the earliest dated source for the Son's promise to return publicly every day/forever?
Can the original table-flipping post, recording or conversation be recovered, and was it actually in 2018?
Who were the actors referred to as 'they' in the table-flipping recollection, rather than assuming every function belonged to Josh Moon or Kiwi Farms?
When do sell/sold, slave/slavery, farm/farming, traffic/trafficking and groom/grooming first appear, and which are metaphor, allegation, event-description or later theology?
Does the pre-meme-cross table-flip chronology genuinely parallel the Synoptic Temple-cleansing-before-Passion sequence once dates are recovered?
How do Joseph's sale/descent pattern and the Passion's hand-over/betrayal pattern differ in explanatory value for the Son chronology?
When does the grain-of-wheat-in-the-heart motif first appear relative to the meme death?
When does Thomas/Didymus/Twin first become attached to the Son?
When does rejected-stone/cornerstone language first appear?
When does the Son first become Door/Vessel rather than merely a person?
How much of the Passion comparison existed before 2019, and how much is retrospective synthesis?
Which parallels become stronger because several functions occur in one dated event-field, and which disappear when provenance is checked?
interpretive_rule: The strongest project argument is chronological, relational and source-directional: identify what existed before later interpretation; preserve co-occurring functions and exact interlocutors; then show how later events reorganized earlier material. Do not reduce dense sequences to one-word coincidences, and do not convert resemblance into proof of supernatural identity or convert project allegations into external facts.
public_reader_summary: The project studies an accumulating Jesus/Son pattern rather than a single identity claim: care and outsider affinity; institutional conflict; imprisonment and scripture; reported Yahya/inmate Jesus-Lamb recognition with witnesses; a later explicit Jesus/crucifixion challenge to Joshua Moon; a remembered anti-martyr attempt to reduce the Son to a nameless/faceless public object; a vow of continual return; resistance to being farmed or commodified; a provisionally dated pre-meme-cross table-flipping episode; persona death; and finally meme-death/burial, Thomas/Twin, grain/seed, Door/Cornerstone and Father-Son architecture. The archive tracks each stage by testimony, provenance, chronology, function and mismatch rather than flattening the sequence into either proof or dismissal.
